_about: The register of published figures LiteratureCheck compares with this repository's results (LITERATURE.md section 1). Typed by hand from the sources, by an AI agent (Claude Code); never by Justin. Each source says who read it (checked_by) and whether Justin has (read_by_justin, false for all until he says otherwise). Statuses: CHECKED (fetched again and the figure matched), READ (fetched and read), SECONDARY (known only through another source, named in via), NOT READ (citation only; nothing from it is used as a figure). A claim's value is exactly as printed; extract says how LiteratureCheck finds it again in the cached copy, so a changed page shows up as a changed figure. The cached pages are not in the repository (copyright): only their URLs, fetch dates and SHA-256 hashes are, under cache. Snapshots are cited only where one already existed; none was requested. The verdict on each claim is computed by LiteratureCheck from compare and if_differs, never typed.
